name: Tsumadori
source:
My wife nursed our baby boy. She gave this family all her love.
Every day was a perfect glorious day.

But... amid that bliss, a crack formed...
I found an online video site starring a woman who looked very much like my wife...

The site used a filter to cover the faces of its actresses.
I refreshed the page over and over trying to get a glimpse...
Inside me an indescribable emotion was surging...
And then I knew the truth. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE086947.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
妻子哺育着我们的小男婴，将所有的爱都给了这个家。
每一天都完美而美好。

然而…幸福之中，出现了裂痕…
我发现一个在线视频网站，影片里的女主角与妻子十分相像…

网站用滤镜遮住了女演员的脸。
我一遍又一遍地刷新页面，试图看清她的模样…
一种无法形容的情绪在我心中翻涌…
随后，我知道了真相。
